items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Now that was $325, and John Kirby was giving me $175 out of his pocket, ripping off these big bills

ctx.x: I know -- and $175 for doing the Roxy Theatre, was scale. Now that was $325, and John Kirby was giving me $175 out of his pocket, ripping off these big bills ...
